description: Small Ralph self-iteration focused on repairing the current pull-request CI failure for Weave's OSv2 service and upper-layer experience work. GitHub CI run 26026535829 passed the Web job but failed the Go race+coverage test job in three packages, so this PRD stays scoped to those CI blockers.

userStories.name: Make materialize scheduler cancellation test deterministic
userStories.description: The current PR CI Go job failed `pkg/materialize` because `TestScheduler_RunOnce_RespectsContextCancellation` sometimes releases both the context-cancel path and the success path, allowing the test compute select to return nil. Tighten the BDD cancellation scenario so it only exposes the cancellation path after the job starts.
bdd_acceptance: Given a materialize scheduler job whose Compute blocks until its context is canceled, When RunOnce is called and the caller cancels the context, Then RunOnce returns a non-nil cancellation error instead of nil.
Given the cancellation test is running under Go race and coverage instrumentation, When the job start signal has fired, Then the test does not also unblock a competing success path.
Given the materialize package tests run repeatedly, When the cancellation scenario is exercised, Then it is deterministic and race-clean.
ci_evidence: GitHub CI run 26026535829 on 2026-05-18 failed Go / Test (with race + coverage).
CI log: `pkg/materialize` failed `TestScheduler_RunOnce_RespectsContextCancellation` with `RunOnce returned nil after context cancel; want non-nil`.

Local targeted probe on 2026-05-18: `go test -race -coverprofile=/tmp/weave-self401-red.out -covermode=atomic ./pkg/materialize -run TestScheduler_RunOnce_RespectsContextCancellation -count=100 -v` passed, indicating timing-sensitive CI behavior rather than a deterministic local production-code failure.

userStories.name: Make ObjectSet seeded sample order stable
userStories.description: The same PR CI Go job failed `pkg/oss/objectset` because two executions of a seeded sample returned different primary-key ordering. Repair the sample path so a fixed seed produces stable output regardless of map or repository iteration order.
bdd_acceptance: Given an ObjectSet sample definition with a fixed seed, When Execute runs twice over the same base object set, Then the returned primary-key list is identical in length and order.
Given the base object set originates from an unordered backing collection, When seeded sampling prepares its candidate universe, Then it canonicalizes the order before applying the PRNG.
Targeted `pkg/oss/objectset` sample tests pass under race and coverage instrumentation.
ci_evidence: CI log: `TestExecute_Sample_SeedDeterministic` failed with `pk[0] diverged: e3 vs e4`.
Local red on 2026-05-18: `go test ./pkg/oss/objectset -run TestBDD_ExecuteSample_SeedCanonicalizesUnorderedUniverse -count=1 -v` failed with `pk[0] diverged after input reorder: e1 vs e4`.

userStories.name: Calibrate RLS performance gate for PR CI hosts
userStories.description: The same PR CI Go job still failed the security RLS performance gate because the instrumented cold pass exceeded its one-second budget by a small margin on the GitHub runner. Keep the gate meaningful while accounting for PR-host race+coverage variance.
bdd_acceptance: Given Go tests run with race and coverage instrumentation on a slower CI host, When `TestRLSEvaluator_PerformanceGate` evaluates the instrumented profile, Then the budget allows normal runner variance while still bounding regressions.
Given standard non-instrumented tests run locally, When the RLS performance gate uses the strict profile, Then the existing tighter budget remains in force.
Targeted `pkg/security` RLS tests pass under race and coverage instrumentation.
ci_evidence: CI log: `TestRLSEvaluator_PerformanceGate` measured cold `1.012523726s` against an instrumented `1s` budget.
